help: SRT or WebVTT cues. Add data drops an existing .srt or .vtt file straight in, so you never need the speech model. Transcribe fills this from the clip wherever on-device speech is available.

label: Caption style
help: Bar runs the full width, Box hugs the words, Outline drops the fill and keeps a readable edge, Karaoke lights each word as it is spoken.

label: Lines per cue
help: How many lines a cue is split across. A very long cue still wraps to fit the frame.

label: Show timecode
help: Prints the cue's in and out times above the words. Handy for review, rarely wanted in a finished frame.

label: Burn captions in
help: On, the cue is drawn over the frame. Off, the frame stays clean and the words travel in the .srt and .vtt sidecars instead.

label: Preview time
help: Which second of the clip the still shows. The cue covering this moment is the one drawn.
